company.description: The merchant or company name printed on the receipt. Return the business name, not a tax registration label, cashier name, or payment provider.

date.description: The transaction date printed on the receipt. Preserve the date as shown and do not return a time, invoice number, or tax registration date.

address.description: The merchant or company address printed on the receipt. Include all address lines belonging to the merchant and exclude customer or delivery addresses.

total.description: The final total amount payable on the receipt. Do not return subtotal, tax, service charge, cash tendered, change, rounding adjustment, or balance before the final total.
